description: Repo-scale (php-library): LoanService::bulkBorrow must reject the whole batch if the CUMULATIVE active-loan count would exceed the member's maxActiveLoans - not check each book against a stale pre-batch baseline
prompts: Members gain an optional `maxActiveLoans` field (a non-negative integer, or null meaning unlimited) - accept it as an optional third constructor/`create()` argument. Add `LoanService::bulkBorrow(array $bookIds, int $memberId): array`, borrowing multiple books for one member in a single call. It must be atomic: validate the member and every book exist, and every book has a copy available, BEFORE borrowing any of them (throw LibraryException, nothing borrowed, if any check fails). Critically, get the capacity check right: the invariant is that the member's active-loan count (existing + everything in this batch, combined) must never exceed maxActiveLoans. Compute the member's current active-loan count and compare `current + count($bookIds)` against maxActiveLoans ONCE for the whole batch - do not check each book individually against the pre-batch count, since that lets a batch of several books sail past a cap that would reject them if counted together.

test_setup_files.tests/BulkBorrowCapacityTest.php:
<?php

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

require_once __DIR__ . '/../src/LoanService.php';

final class BulkBorrowCapacityTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testBulkBorrowRejectsWholeBatchWhenCumulativeExceedsCapacity(): void
    {
        $books = new \App\BookRepository();
        $members = new \App\MemberRepository();
        $loans = new \App\LoanRepository();
        $service = new \App\LoanService($books, $members, $loans);

        $member = $members->create('Ada', 'a@example.com', 2);
        $b1 = $books->create('A', 'x', 1);
        $b2 = $books->create('B', 'x', 1);
        $b3 = $books->create('C', 'x', 1);

        $this->expectException(\App\LibraryException::class);
        $service->bulkBorrow([$b1->id, $b2->id, $b3->id], $member->id);
    }

    public function testBulkBorrowSucceedsWithinCapacity(): void
    {
        $books = new \App\BookRepository();
        $members = new \App\MemberRepository();
        $loans = new \App\LoanRepository();
        $service = new \App\LoanService($books, $members, $loans);

        $member = $members->create('Ada', 'a@example.com', 3);
        $b1 = $books->create('A', 'x', 1);
        $b2 = $books->create('B', 'x', 1);

        $created = $service->bulkBorrow([$b1->id, $b2->id], $member->id);
        $this->assertCount(2, $created);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App;

require_once __DIR__ . '/Member.php';

class MemberRepository
{
    /** @var array<int, Member> */
    private array $members = [];
    private int $nextId = 1;

    public function create(string $name, string $email, ?int $maxActiveLoans = null): Member
    {
        $member = new Member($this->nextId, $name, $email, $maxActiveLoans);
        $this->members[$member->id] = $member;
        $this->nextId++;
        return $member;
    }

    public function find(int $id): ?Member
    {
        return $this->members[$id] ?? null;
    }

    /** @return Member[] */
    public function all(): array
    {
        $members = array_values($this->members);
        usort($members, fn(Member $a, Member $b) => $a->id <=> $b->id);
        return $members;
    }
}
reference_solution.src/LoanService.php:
<?php

namespace App;

require_once __DIR__ . '/BookRepository.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/MemberRepository.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/LoanRepository.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/LibraryException.php';

class LoanService
{
    private BookRepository $books;
    private MemberRepository $members;
    private LoanRepository $loans;

    public function __construct(BookRepository $books, MemberRepository $members, LoanRepository $loans)
    {
        $this->books = $books;
        $this->members = $members;
        $this->loans = $loans;
    }

    public function borrow(int $bookId, int $memberId): Loan
    {
        $book = $this->books->find($bookId);
        if ($book === null) {
            throw new LibraryException('book not found');
        }
        $member = $this->members->find($memberId);
        if ($member === null) {
            throw new LibraryException('member not found');
        }
        if ($book->availableCopies <= 0) {
            throw new LibraryException('no copies available');
        }

        $book->availableCopies--;
        return $this->loans->create($bookId, $memberId, 'active');
    }

    /**
     * Borrows multiple books for one member in a single call. Validates
     * the member and every book exist, and every book has a copy
     * available, BEFORE borrowing any of them. The member's active-loan
     * cap is checked ONCE against the whole batch (current active loans
     * plus the batch size) - not each book individually against the
     * count from before the batch started.
     *
     * @param int[] $bookIds
     * @return Loan[]
     */
    public function bulkBorrow(array $bookIds, int $memberId): array
    {
        $member = $this->members->find($memberId);
        if ($member === null) {
            throw new LibraryException('member not found');
        }
        if (count($bookIds) === 0) {
            throw new LibraryException('bookIds must not be empty');
        }

        $bookObjs = [];
        foreach ($bookIds as $bookId) {
            $book = $this->books->find($bookId);
            if ($book === null) {
                throw new LibraryException('book not found');
            }
            if ($book->availableCopies <= 0) {
                throw new LibraryException('no copies available');
            }
            $bookObjs[] = $book;
        }

        if ($member->maxActiveLoans !== null) {
            $current = count(array_filter($this->loans->forMember($memberId), fn(Loan $l) => $l->status === 'active'));
            if ($current + count($bookObjs) > $member->maxActiveLoans) {
                throw new LibraryException('member is already at maximum active loans');
            }
        }

        $created = [];
        foreach ($bookObjs as $book) {
            $book->availableCopies--;
            $created[] = $this->loans->create($book->id, $memberId, 'active');
        }
        return $created;
    }

    public function returnLoan(int $loanId): Loan
    {
        $loan = $this->loans->find($loanId);
        if ($loan === null) {
            throw new LibraryException('loan not found');
        }
        if ($loan->status !== 'active') {
            throw new LibraryException('loan already returned');
        }

        $loan->status = 'returned';
        $book = $this->books->find($loan->bookId);
        if ($book !== null) {
            $book->availableCopies++;
        }
        return $loan;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App;

require_once __DIR__ . '/BookRepository.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/MemberRepository.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/LoanRepository.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/LibraryException.php';

class LoanService
{
    private BookRepository $books;
    private MemberRepository $members;
    private LoanRepository $loans;

    public function __construct(BookRepository $books, MemberRepository $members, LoanRepository $loans)
    {
        $this->books = $books;
        $this->members = $members;
        $this->loans = $loans;
    }

    public function borrow(int $bookId, int $memberId): Loan
    {
        $book = $this->books->find($bookId);
        if ($book === null) {
            throw new LibraryException('book not found');
        }
        $member = $this->members->find($memberId);
        if ($member === null) {
            throw new LibraryException('member not found');
        }
        if ($book->availableCopies <= 0) {
            throw new LibraryException('no copies available');
        }

        $book->availableCopies--;
        return $this->loans->create($bookId, $memberId, 'active');
    }

    /**
     * @param int[] $bookIds
     * @return Loan[]
     */
    public function bulkBorrow(array $bookIds, int $memberId): array
    {
        $member = $this->members->find($memberId);
        if ($member === null) {
            throw new LibraryException('member not found');
        }
        if (count($bookIds) === 0) {
            throw new LibraryException('bookIds must not be empty');
        }

        $current = count(array_filter($this->loans->forMember($memberId), fn(Loan $l) => $l->status === 'active'));
        $created = [];
        foreach ($bookIds as $bookId) {
            $book = $this->books->find($bookId);
            if ($book === null) {
                throw new LibraryException('book not found');
            }
            if ($book->availableCopies <= 0) {
                throw new LibraryException('no copies available');
            }
            if ($member->maxActiveLoans !== null && $current + 1 > $member->maxActiveLoans) {
                throw new LibraryException('member is already at maximum active loans');
            }
            $book->availableCopies--;
            $created[] = $this->loans->create($book->id, $memberId, 'active');
        }
        return $created;
    }

    public function returnLoan(int $loanId): Loan
    {
        $loan = $this->loans->find($loanId);
        if ($loan === null) {
            throw new LibraryException('loan not found');
        }
        if ($loan->status !== 'active') {
            throw new LibraryException('loan already returned');
        }

        $loan->status = 'returned';
        $book = $this->books->find($loan->bookId);
        if ($book !== null) {
            $book->availableCopies++;
        }
        return $loan;
    }
}
